title: PotentialEP: Backprop-Free Training of CIFAR-Scale Generative Models via Equilibrium Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14409v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generating an image with a diffusion or flow-matching model typically involves integrating a velocity field for hundreds of sequential steps. That computation suits a GPU poorly and an analog neuromorphic substrate well, where one fast, low-power physical relaxation could replace the whole sequence. Two things are needed: a generative algorithm whose computation is a relaxation, and a way to train it without backpropagation, whose global gradient transport is hard to realise in analog. Energy Matching supplies the first, sampling by gradient-descent relaxation on a time-independent potential - but obtaining the gradient that descent follows is itself a backward pass, once per integration step. We prove that a predictive coding network with a single linear injection term added to its energy relaxes to a state whose visible layer carries that gradient inherently, with an error that vanishes for small injection strengths. translated_abstract: 使用扩散模型或流匹配模型生成图像，通常需要对速度场进行数百个连续步骤的积分。这种计算并不适合GPU，却非常适合模拟神经形态基底——在那里，一次快速、低功耗的物理弛豫即可替代整个计算序列。要实现这一点需要两样东西：一个是计算过程本身即为弛豫的生成算法，另一种是不依赖反向传播的训练方法，因为反向传播所需的全局梯度传输在模拟硬件中难以实现。能量匹配提供了前者，它通过在时间无关势能上进行梯度下降弛豫来采样——但获取该梯度下降所遵循的梯度本身仍需一次反向传播，且每个积分步骤都需要执行一次。我们证明，在能量函数中加入单个线性注入项的预测编码网络，会弛豫到一个其可见层天然携带该梯度的状态，且当注入强度较小时误差趋于消失。一个能量匹
tldr: 该论文提出PotentialEP方法，证明加入单个线性注入项的预测编码网络在弛豫过程中其可见层可天然携带能量匹配所需的梯度，从而实现无需反向传播的CIFAR规模生成模型训练，适配模拟神经形态硬件。
